== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[There'll Be Hell To Pay]]. Columns are Original and PC Errata only. Appendix A reprints the Grabber sentence; the rest of the printed game text is unchanged. Glossary 2.0 / Supplement are rulings, not a Decipher Errata column. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
